item.title: Hot Jazz Saturday Night: February 28, 2026
item.description: The song title, “Strange Fruit” was a metaphor for lynching. In 1939, Columbia Records granted singer Billie Holiday release from her contract to record “Strange Fruit” for the Commodore label. Listen for “Strange Fruit” and Billie’s other recordings for Commodore this week on Hot Jazz Saturday Night.
